rubric.4: Application provides a real-time multiplayer drawing canvas that broadcasts drawing activity to all connected players without requiring page refreshes.
rubric.5: Application implements a turn-taking system that designates exactly one player as the drawing player while all other players act as guessers.
rubric.6: Application assigns a vocabulary word to the drawing player at the start of each turn and ensures that only that player can see the word.
rubric.7: Application ensures that all vocabulary words are drawn from an age-appropriate list suitable for elementary school students.
rubric.8: Application provides a live chat interface that allows players to submit guesses in real time.
rubric.9: Application automatically detects when a player’s guess matches the correct word and updates game state accordingly.
rubric.10: Application tracks and updates scores for each player based on correct guesses and defined scoring rules.
rubric.11: Application delivers real-time updates for drawing strokes, guesses, scores, and turn changes to all players without requiring page reloads.
rubric.12: Application implements clear game start and game end states so players understand when a match begins, progresses, and concludes.
rubric.13: Application persists all user accounts and player score data using durable database-backed storage.
rubric.14: Application provides a lobby view that lists all available public rooms.
rubric.15: Application displays for each public room in the lobby its name or identifier, the current number of players, and the maximum capacity.
rubric.16: Application allows users to select and join any public room that is not full.
rubric.17: Application updates lobby information in real time as players join rooms, leave rooms, or new rooms are created.
rubric.18: Application clearly indicates in the lobby when a room is full and when it is currently in progress.
rubric.19: Application records the drawing strokes for each round in a manner that preserves their exact order and timing.
rubric.20: Application allows players, after a round ends and the correct word has been revealed, to watch a replay of that round’s drawing.
rubric.21: Application provides replay playback controls, including at minimum play, pause, and restart.
rubric.22: Application ensures replays are synchronized for all players who choose to view them simultaneously.
rubric.23: Application persists or caches replay data for at least the duration of the game session so players can rewatch recent rounds.
